correctness.rationale: For m>=2, 2m+1 generic separate-block invariant quadrics are smooth dim 2m and avoid both fixed P^(2m), giving a free C2 quotient. Integral Lefschetz identifies H^q(Y,Z) with ambient for q<2m. Natural Borel spectral-sequence comparison plus even-cell/no-low-differential argument yields truncated ring of ambient equivariant projective bundle: Z[h,t]/(2t, h^(2m+1)(h+t)^(2m+1)). The high-degree relation is irrelevant for q<2m, giving H^(2j)=Z+(Z/2)^j, odd zero, t^j≠0 for j<m. Canonical character is the nontrivial sign from determinant of the ambient linear lift and invariant quadrics. Pic=H² via H¹(O)=H²(O)=0 on the quotient. Strict cutoff and m=2 boundary were checked; the monomial script is only a sanity check.
residual_risks: No middle-degree or full cohomology claim; relation h^(2m+1)(h+t)^(2m+1) matters outside range.
